name: NARUTO: World of Dreams
source:
Obito's plan, "Eternal Tsukuyomi", was a success, and the player gets a chance to see the perfect world of each character. But do not expect that everything will be easy! Even in this world, you will have to work hard to achieve happiness.

[From [url=https://kiobe.itch.io/naruto-wd]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
带土的计划“永恒的月读”获得了成功，玩家有机会看到每个角色的完美世界。但不要指望一切都会很容易！即使在这个世界上，你也必须努力工作才能获得幸福。

[来自[url=https://kiobe.itch.io/naruto-wd]itch.io[/url]]
